subject: Fix proto_to_core_fir to preserve Search/Index/HeadTail/Operator structure
description: Fixed 26 of 56 cross-check failures. Key changes: (1) proto_to_core_fir now preserves Search/Index/HeadTail structure with correct anchored/anchor/target/direction, (2) SearchFir uses ECONSTANIC for unbound names, (3) SF evaluation uses Foolishly ignorance to block brane results, (4) Operator NK preserves structure, (5) Concatenation evaluates merged brane, (6) Index negative clamping matches UBC, (7) Forward reference support via entries fallback. Remaining 30 failures are due to UBC's re_step_brane_bodies architecture vs UBCa's single-pass evaluation.
